meta.name: create-chatgpt-video-ad
meta.description: Produce a 9:16 social-native ad that recreates a ChatGPT mobile chat — user types in the composer with the iOS keyboard visible, taps send, keyboard slides down, header right-cluster swaps (personPlus/dotted → edit/more), one gray loading dot appears, then the assistant response streams in word-by-word with a soft opacity ramp. Continuous Playwright recording, subtle SFX (key-tap / send-tap / stream-tick / response-done), assembled into a master MP4 plus 9:16 / 1×1 exports. No music bed and no end card by default.
